title: cicer chorassanicum
intro: Cicer chorassanicum, commonly known as Chorasan chickpea or Chorassanic chickpea, is a plant species of the genus Cicer, native to the Chorasan region of Central Asia. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood sugar, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cicer chorassanicum are attributed to its ability to modulate the gut microbiota, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in Cicer chorassanicum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
